CustomField.description: Restricted picklist. Legal values: **CreateTransactions** (normal), **PauseTransactions** (suspended without deleting the schedule). Used by the managed `frops_flow__PauseResumeSchedule` action to pause / resume without deleting schedule history. Default: `CreateTransactions`.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose *Create Transactions* for a schedule that generates gift transactions as installments come due. Choose *Pause Transactions* to suspend installment generation temporarily — the schedule stays attached but stops producing new gifts.
